Kitchen, meals & drinks

colander noun

also strainer, sieve

classical

Cato
Verg.

cōlum, cōlī n.

noun, second declension

strainer, colander

Morgan–Owens: the cōlum strains liquids; the crībrum sifts solids.

Examples

  • Collȳram in cōlum effunde.

    Drain the pasta in the colander.composed

Other words

  • cōlum majus — colander for pasta

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. sieve: colander

See also slotted spoon.

SourcesLewis & Short: colum · Lewis & Short: cribrum
